newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran police seize 470 kg of drugs from camel gang.
newsitem.headline: Iran police seize 470 kg of drugs from camel gang.

text.p: Police is southeastern Iran clashed with armed narcotics traffickers using camels to carry drugs, and seized 470 kg (1,034 lb) of opium and heroin, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Monday.

It said police were still chasing the smugglers who got away after the shootout in a mountainous region near the borders of Afghanistan and Pakistan on Sunday, leaving behind 450 kg of opium, 20 kg of heroin and three camels.
Iran lies on a major transit route for drugs smuggled to Europe via Turkey from Afghanistan and Pakistan -- the so-called "Golden Crescent".
